en: So how can we use HTMX on that website here?

get started with HTMX by making sure that
when I click this button here, I
load and display some extra data on that

Now, in order to do that, we need to
install
HTMX. We need to add it to our application
here.
And when it comes to installing HTMX, you
have different options,
though the easiest way of adding it is to
add such a CDN link here
or
to download HTMX and host it on your server
and then import and load it from there.
You could also npm install it, but since
we'll not execute it on the server and since
here I don't have a project with some build

bundle,
that's not how we'll add it here. And
indeed, it is pretty common and most likely
the most common way of including HTMX to use

Therefore, what I'll do here
is I'll download a copy.

copy all the code in there.
And I'll then go to the public folder in my
project
and add an HTMX.js file. The name is up to

which I copied in there and then save it.
This code, by the way, is of course minified
and optimized, so you can't really read it

the end.
Now, just having this file here is not

it's included in my webpage.
And my webpage in the end is this
HTML code that's sent back as a response by
Express here.
So in order to load HTMX, I'll add a script
import here
like this with script tags opening and
closing and set the src attribute on that
opening script tag to /htmx.js.
And that will load it from the public folder
due to the way this Node Express server is
configured.
It is configured such that it serves files
from that public folder without problems.
So that's how we load it. I'll also add the
defer attribute here on that script import
to make sure that the script will only
execute after the rest of the page has been
rendered so that if I'm using HTMX anywhere
in there,
the script is ready to handle that usage.
Well, and that's all. With that, we
installed it and we can now use it.
